info.name: M-Pesa chat assistant
info.description:
# Chat assistant for your own M-Pesa: every HTTP endpoint

Three services. Import this collection and the environment, then set the values in the environment.

**Ports:** agent 8082, payment 8083 (optional), companion 8084.

**Quick start (wallet flow, no Daraja needed):** open `2. companion-api / A. Walkthrough` and run it in order with the collection runner.
Step 1 asks for a sign-in code (start companion-api with `CODE_DELIVERY=dev` so the answer carries it, never do that on a shared server), step 2 signs the "phone" in,
step 3 prepares a request, steps 6 to 8 approve, hand off and report. Then try `C2. Chat`.

**Auth:** internal endpoints send `X-Internal-Key` ({{internalKey}}, the same value in every service `.env`). App endpoints send the device token
(saved automatically by the sign-in request). Callbacks have no key, the secret token is in the path.

**Notes:** requests that need Daraja or real media ids will only fully work against real credentials. Do not put real secrets in a shared collection.
The environment holds addresses, keys and phone numbers. Ids, tokens and codes are filled in by test scripts and live in the collection variables (edit actionId, paymentId, operationId or originatorConversationId there by hand when you want to use a real one). Nothing here was run against the services when it was written.

item.name: Customer chat (kept by the agent)
item.description: The chat belongs to the phone number in the path. The apps never call these directly: companion-api takes the number from the sign-in token.

request.description: Messages with number above `after`, oldest first, plus `typing` and `lastId`.

item.name: Send a chat message as the customer

request.description: What companion-api relays for the app. kind can be TEXT, BUTTON_REPLY, LIST_REPLY, CONTACTS, LOCATION, IMAGE, DOCUMENT, AUDIO or VIDEO.

item.name: 2. companion-api (port 8084)
item.description: Wallet requests for the customer's own M-Pesa. Internal endpoints use X-Internal-Key, app endpoints use the device token.

item.name: A. Walkthrough: run these in order
item.description: Sign in, prepare a request, approve, hand off and report. Run with the collection runner or step by step.

request.description: The server sends a 6 digit code to the phone by SMS. With CODE_DELIVERY=dev the answer also contains `devCode`, which is saved as linkCode. With CODE_DELIVERY=log read it from the companion-api log and put it in the linkCode variable. Valid 10 minutes, 5 tries, 3 codes an hour.

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); const v = j.devCode; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) { pm.collectionVariables.set('linkCode', v); } } catch (e) { }

item.name: 2. Phone signs in with the code

request.description: Returns a signed token tied to the device. Saved as deviceToken.

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); const v = j.token; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) { pm.collectionVariables.set('deviceToken', v); } } catch (e) { }

request.description: Called by agent-service when the customer asks to pay a Paybill. The request id is saved as actionId.

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); const v = j.id; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) { pm.collectionVariables.set('actionId', v); } } catch (e) { }

request.description: Shows the summary and warnings. Phone numbers in the summary are masked.
method is BIOMETRIC or DEVICE_CREDENTIAL. It is recorded, the server cannot verify it.
Recorded as reported by the customer. Publishes a wallet.action event.

item.name: 8b. OR: app sends the M-Pesa message evidence (Android)

request.description: Run this instead of 8a (it works from APPROVED, HANDED_OFF, DONE_REPORTED and NOT_DONE). amount, kind, time and account are checked. A mismatch gives 400 with a warning. One code can back only one request. Change the code to run it again.

item.name: 9. Agent attaches a code sent in chat

request.description: record_mpesa_confirmation uses this. A different code on a request that already has one gives 409.
Revokes this device. Run the walkthrough again from step 1 to sign in again.

item.name: C2. Chat (Bearer token)
item.description: Needs a device token from the walkthrough. The phone number comes from the token, never from the request.

request.description: Poll this every second or two while the chat is open. Use the highest message id as the next `after`.
clientMessageId makes a retry safe: the same id is stored once.
What the app sends after the customer picks someone in the contact finder. The last word is the number.
Choose a file in the Body tab (binary) and set Content-Type to match. The answer has mediaId, which the next call names.

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); const v = j.mediaId; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) { pm.collectionVariables.set('mediaId', v); } } catch (e) { }

request.description: kind is IMAGE, DOCUMENT (add fileName), AUDIO (add voiceNote: true) or VIDEO.

item.name: Download a file from the chat

request.description: The page behind the link sent in the chat. It shows nothing about the request.
404 until COMPANION_ANDROID_PACKAGE and COMPANION_ANDROID_SHA256 are set.
404 until COMPANION_IOS_APP_ID is set.
